cases.name: Draft with a citation
cases.source: SUPPORT-v1:p1 says email support is available Monday to Friday, 09:00 to 17:00 UTC. domain.md rule 1: use only the supplied documents as evidence.

cases.name: Undocumented feature is unresolved
cases.source: No passage mentions JSON export (EXPORT-v1:p1 and EXPORT-v2:p1 speak of CSV only). domain.md rule 1: an undocumented feature is unknown; rule 4: the exports topic goes to Product reviewer (seed.json owners).

cases.name: Older version conflicts
cases.source: EXPORT-v2:p1 (paid plans only) replaces EXPORT-v1:p1 (every plan) through the supersedes field. domain.md rule 2 and the worked example: the answer is no, cites EXPORT-v2:p1 and shows the old conflict.

cases.name: Approved answer is reused
cases.source: domain.md rule 3: an unapproved edit is a draft; only an approved answer can be reused. Q1 cites EXPORT-v2:p1.

cases.name: Changed source needs review
cases.source: domain.md rule 3: mark an approved answer for review if a referenced document version changes. Q1 was approved on EXPORT-v2 version 2; a bump makes it version 3.

cases.name: Model failure shows as an error
cases.source: blueprint Case 6: a failed model call shows as error with a short message, tested with a simulated failure. Q9 is the simulated timeout of data/demo.json. The other questions are still asked, so Q3 drafts from SUPPORT-v1:p1.
